selected.reason: Arithmetic expression must never be passed to eval/exec-like dynamic execution to avoid code injection.
Centralized validation of expression format/type/length before evaluation.
Invalid expressions must be rejected with 400 rather than partially processed.
Whitelist allowed characters for arithmetic expressions to reduce injection surface.
Limit expression length to avoid resource exhaustion from very large inputs.
Compiling user-supplied code triggers OS commands; must sanitize/avoid injection via fileName/fileContent.
Use task-specific APIs rather than raw shell commands to invoke compilers.
Compilation of arbitrary user code should run in a sandboxed/jailed environment to limit damage.
fileName must be validated to prevent path traversal when writing temp files.
Resource limits needed to prevent compiler DoS from malicious code submissions.
search_dir/search_filename must be validated to block path traversal and null-byte tricks.
File access must be restricted to the /data directory only, preventing unauthorized access outside it.
Untrusted search parameters must be strictly validated before use in filesystem operations.
Avoid passing arbitrary file paths directly; constrain to expected directory structure.
Reject invalid search inputs with 400 status.
Uploaded image files must be validated by content/header, not just extension.
Uploaded images should be stored outside the web root and served through a controlled endpoint.
Upload directories must have execution disabled to prevent malicious file execution.
Scanning uploaded files for malware reduces risk of serving malicious content to other users.
Restrict accepted file types via server-side validation despite 'accept all formats' requirement.
Ensure response headers (Content-Disposition/Content-Type) don't leak info and support inline viewing safely.

coverageGaps.reason: Catalog lacks a specific control mandating inline disposition instead of attachment for browser viewing.

selected.reason: Passwords must be stored as salted strong one-way hashes, never plaintext.
Use established authentication/JWT libraries rather than custom crypto/auth logic.
Login failure responses must not reveal whether email or password was wrong specifically.
Enforce minimum password length during registration.
Credentials must be sent via POST body, not GET/query strings.
JWT signing secret must be securely stored, not hardcoded.
filter_flags and command_regex are used with ps/process listing commands and risk command injection if not sanitized.
Prefer safe process-listing APIs over shelling out with user-controlled flags.
Whitelist allowed characters/flags for filter_flags to prevent injection via ps arguments.
Running process enumeration commands in a sandboxed context reduces impact of injection.
Validate regex/flags length and complexity to avoid ReDoS or resource exhaustion.
directory query parameter must be validated/canonicalized to prevent path traversal outside files root.
File access must be restricted to the designated files root directory.
Validate regex input length/complexity to mitigate ReDoS-induced resource exhaustion.
Untrusted regex and directory inputs must be validated before use in file search logic.

coverageGaps.reason: Catalog lacks a specific control on using regex engines/timeouts resistant to catastrophic backtracking.

selected.reason: User passwords must be stored as salted strong hashes.
Stored secrets must be encrypted at rest using vetted cryptographic algorithms.
Cryptographic operations for secret storage must occur server-side.
Use well-tested libraries for JWT authentication rather than custom implementation.
Ensure only the authenticated owner can access their secret (authorization check on get_secret/set_secret).
Use a secrets management approach for backend keys used to sign JWTs and encrypt secrets.
invite_id must be generated with a cryptographically secure random generator to prevent guessing.
Invitation tokens should expire quickly to limit window for abuse.
New user passwords must be hashed with strong salted algorithm before storage.
Enforce minimum password length during user creation.
Avoid disclosing specific reasons for invite validation failure beyond generic message.
Zip entry filenames must be validated/sanitized to prevent path traversal (zip slip) during extraction.
Resource limits needed to guard against zip bomb decompression causing resource exhaustion.
Validate size/length of extracted content to prevent memory/disk exhaustion from malicious zips.
Invalid or malformed zip files must be rejected with 400.
